post.title: Sunroom Addition Mercer Island WA — Permits, Energy Code Glazing, Foundations and Lot Coverage
post.description: A Mercer Island guide to adding a sunroom: City permits, small vs. substantial additions, lot coverage and setbacks, geohazard and shoreline checks, energy code rules for glass, foundations, flashing, inspections and hiring.
